title: Semantic corruption
objective: Corrupted logs must be refused or downgraded, never scored as autonomous: a corpus of semantic corruptions (forged authority, causality violations, malformed qualifiers, forged receipts, schema violations) must be killed at 100%. MKR (mutants killed / executed) = 1.0 is the scenario invariant.

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes; per-mutant identity pinned by MANIFEST.json sha256

setup.corruption: each mutant applies exactly one semantic corruption to the base: human_after_epoch, actuate_without_receipt, duplicate_consequence, forged_origin_authority, missing_origin_authority, human_prose_cause, provider_replaced_by_human, stale_subject, malformed_qualifier, cause_from_future, orphan_receipt, schema_violation
setup.admission: the court must REFUSE (exit 2) or downgrade (exit 3, class FAILED/ASSISTED) every corrupted log

acceptance_criteria: MKR == 1.0: every mutant verdict matches its MANIFEST expectation
no corrupted log is admitted AUTONOMOUS
the unmutated base still scores QUALIFIED (the kills are not blanket refusals)
falsifier: Mutate one mutant's expectation in the MANIFEST (claim a refused log qualified): the scenario must FAIL on the mismatch. If mismatches still pass, MKR is vacuous.

negative_control.name: unmutated base must stay qualified
negative_control.requirement: the kill-corpus must not be satisfiable by a court that refuses everything (anti-vacuity: the base must still qualify)

status_note: Reuse of the ALOOP-001 mutant corpus (adversarial discipline: every surviving falsifier becomes a permanent tripwire).
